|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Han's Dice (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Cancel Watto's Chance Cube. OR If one of your characters of ability > 2 is in a battle, use 1 Force to cancel a just drawn destiny and cause a redraw. Once per turn, when drawn for destiny, may take into hand to cause a redraw.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “''Once per turn, if just drawn for destiny, may take this Interrupt into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny.'' OR Cancel Watto’s Chance Cube. OR If your character of ability > 2 is in battle, use 1 Force to cancel and redraw a just drawn destiny.” '''What changed:''' added “''Once per turn, if just drawn for destiny, may take this Interrupt into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny.'' OR”; “Watto's” → “Watto’s”; removed “one of”; “characters” → “character”; removed “a”; added “and redraw”; “destiny and cause a redraw. Once per turn, when drawn for destiny, may take into hand to cause a redraw.” → “destiny.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards2.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 09. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Han's Dice]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour#Cards|Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
